messages:
harper: Short thread to finalize the private deploy launch priorities for next release. Need clarity on MVP networking mode, upgrade default, telemetry policy, and recommended field comms. Quick inputs please.

sven: Propose default: operator + relay for fastest onramp. Offer NAT (static egress) as second mode. BGP is enterprise opt-in with SE coordination.

leah: Agree. For upgrades default to rolling canary (configurable), with an automated canary abort on smoke failures. Blue/green will be documented as an advanced pattern and not the launch default.

mika: Telemetry: default OFF for private deployments. Add explicit CLI consent that generates a signed audit token when enabled (`redwoodctl telemetry consent --scopes=errors,latency`). Also add `redwoodctl install --preflight-only --output=json`.

harper: Launch criteria draft: 1) Installer preflight completes and prints machine-readable results; 2) Rolling upgrade with canary and auto-rollback implemented; 3) Relay must be validated with at least one staging customer; 4) Telemetry default OFF and opt-in flow documented.

sven: Preflight checklist should include firewall ports, nftables vs iptables detection, MTU mismatch check, and detection of legacy LB SNATs. Add automated checks for DNS records referencing egress IPs.

leah: Field asks: include a customer-facing maintenance window template. Draft: "Planned upgrades target minimal disruption; typical rolling upgrades complete in 15-60 minutes. Network-level cutovers (VIP/BGP) may require scheduled coordination and up to 2 hours."

mika: For BGP onboarding, offer an "enterprise migration pack" (2-day SE engagement) and vendor-agnostic BGP snippets in docs. Mark BGP as paid/advanced and gated behind a checklist.

harper: Action items: Sven -> preflight checklist + NAT/VIP template (due Wed), Mika -> telemetry CLI & consent token spec (due Tue), Leah -> canary rollout config and abort criteria (due Tue). I'll draft RFC and book a 30min review.

infra-bot: Created ticket PD-9800 "private-deploy networking defaults & rollout" and assigned to @harper, @sven, @leah, @mika.

sven: One more: for NAT mode include an HA reference architecture (two NAT gateways + failover IP) so customers don't introduce SPOF.

leah: ack

harper: Locking decisions for RFC prep. Thanks all. :thumbsup
thread_text_summary: Decisions: operator+relay default, NAT for egress preservation, BGP enterprise opt-in with SE migration pack; rolling canary upgrades with auto-rollback; telemetry default OFF; preflight checklist and action owners assigned
